=== a large-model function with a pushm frame
        .text
        .globl  func
func:   pushm.a #4, r10
        mova    r12, r10
        movx.w  &0x10000, r11
        addx.a  r11, r10
        calla   #helper
        popm.a  #4, r10
        reta
helper: reta

=== 20-bit arithmetic
        .text
        mova    #0x12345, r12
        adda    #0x10000, r12
        suba    r13, r12
        cmpa    #0xfffff, r12
        jz      1f
        incdx.a r12
        decx.a  r13
1:      reta

=== repeated shifts
        .text
        mov     #4, r14
        rpt     r14
        rrax.w  r12
        rpt     #16
        rlax.a  r13
        rrcm.a  #4, r12
        rram    #2, r13
        rlam.a  #3, r14
        rrum    #1, r15
        rpt     #3 { rrux r12
        reta

=== far memory through the extension words
        .text
        movx.a  &0x12345, r5
        movx.a  r5, &0x54321
        movx    0x12345(r4), 0x2(r6)
        movx.b  #0xff, &0x20000
        bicx.a  #0xf0000, r7
        bisx.a  #0x10000, 0x10000(r8)
        pushx.a &0x12344
        popx.a  r9
        tstx.a  0x10002(r10)
        swpbx   r11
        sxtx.a  r12
        reta

=== address instructions in every form
        .text
        mova    r4, r5
        mova    @r4, r5
        mova    @r4+, r5
        mova    &0x12345, r5
        mova    0x1234(r4), r5
        mova    #0x54321, r5
        mova    r4, &0x12346
        mova    r4, 0x1234(r5)
        bra     r4
        bra     @r4
        bra     @r4+
        bra     #0x12344
        calla   r4
        calla   @r4
        calla   @r4+
        calla   0x10(r4)
        reta

=== the core instruction set on the MSP430X
        .text
        mov     #0x1234, r5
        push    #4
        push    #8
        call    #0x8000
        br      #0x8000
        mov.b   @r4+, 0(r5)
        jmp     $+4
        ret
